profile.headline: Software Engineer Sr - CoreAI
profile.summary:
AI Engineer with 5+ years of experience building full-stack applications, backend systems, and AI-enabled platforms, with a focus on LLM systems, evaluation, and production reliability.
 
Previously at Verizon, where I designed and delivered production-grade backend services integrating LLM-based document extraction pipelines, automation systems, and APIs to support financial, compliance, and operational workflows at scale.
 
My work focuses on building reliable AI systems, including LLM-powered pipelines, structured validation layers, and ML-based applications, with an emphasis on mitigating hallucination risk, improving output consistency, and handling real-world failure modes.
 
I bring strong end-to-end ownership, driving systems from design through testing, evaluation, and deployment while collaborating cross-functionally with product, analytics, and infrastructure teams. I am particularly interested in AI systems that require correctness, interpretability, and production-level performance.
 
Core technologies: Python, FastAPI, JavaScript/TypeScript, Node.js, React, LLMs, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), model evaluation frameworks, data pipelines, and system design.
 
Open to opportunities in AI Engineering, Applied AI, and LLM systems where I can help build reliable, production-ready AI infrastructure.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
Software Development Engineer building full-stack applications, backend services, and AI-enabled systems supporting financial, compliance, and operational workflows in a large-scale enterprise environment.

• Designed and implemented backend services and REST APIs to automate financial contract data extraction using LLM-based workflows, incorporating schema validation, error handling, and deterministic outputs, reducing compliance review effort by ~50%.
• Built and maintained full-stack applications using Node.js, React, and Python, implementing secure authentication, input validation, and production reliability controls.
• Automated and scaled 10+ KPI and reporting workflows using API integrations, Google Apps Script, and Smartsheet, improving executive submission response time by 40%.
• Served as technical owner for internal services, driving initiatives end-to-end from system design through UAT, deployment, and cross-functional delivery.
• Engineered ML-powered systems including facial recognition (TensorFlow) and handwriting recognition (MyScript), applying validation logic, confidence thresholds, and user testing across 10 participants.
• Integrated LLM-powered document extraction pipelines with structured validation layers to mitigate hallucination risk and ensure consistent outputs in compliance workflows.
• Built data pipelines and analytics dashboards (Qlik Sense, Looker Studio) to monitor risk, performance, and operational KPIs.

Technologies: Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, Node.js, React, Claude Code, Google Gemini, REST APIs, LLMs, Data Pipelines, System Design, Automation, Validation, UAT
